rationale: Water damage from the policyholder's own plumbing failure affecting basement structure and contents is a direct property damage claim with clear coverage under the homeowners policy.
claim_summary: Basement flooded from burst supply line under upstairs bathroom sink that ran for approximately 2 days while policyholder was traveling. Damage includes buckled hardwood flooring, soaked drywall (up to 1 foot), and ruined stored boxes. Estimated loss $8,000–$15,000; deductible $500.

case_facts.description: Basement flooded with approximately 2 inches of water
case_facts.damage_details: Hardwood floor buckled, drywall soaked up to 1 foot, stored boxes ruined
case_facts.incident_cause: Burst supply line under upstairs bathroom sink
